{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "incident_delay_reasons",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "resolution_hours",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "restatement",
      "rationale": "This is the magnitude of the delay outcome itself (how long resolution took), not a constitutive aspect/reason of the delay. It restates the whole 'delay' rather than decomposing its reasons."
    },
    {
      "name": "priority_numeric",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "Priority is an attribute of the incident that may correlate with or predict delay, but it is not a part-of the concept 'delay reasons'; it is an external driver."
    },
    {
      "name": "category_mismatch",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "cause",
      "rationale": "A misclassified category could be a potential cause of delay, but a cause is not a constitutive facet (an aspect OF) of the delay-reasons concept."
    },
    {
      "name": "opened_hour",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "Time of day the incident opened is a contextual predictor, not an aspect that constitutes the reasons for delay."
    },
    {
      "name": "opened_day_of_week",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "Day of week is a temporal covariate/predictor of delay, not a constitutive part of the delay-reasons concept."
    },
    {
      "name": "is_weekend",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "Weekend flag is a derived temporal predictor of delay, overlapping with opened_day_of_week, and not a facet of the concept itself."
    }
  ],
  "facet_columns": [],
  "non_facet_columns": [
    "resolution_hours",
    "priority_numeric",
    "category_mismatch",
    "opened_hour",
    "opened_day_of_week",
    "is_weekend"
  ],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.0,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.0,
  "rationale": "None of the added columns are constitutive facets (parts-of) the concept 'incident_delay_reasons'. A proper faceted decomposition would carve delay reasons into non-overlapping aspects such as triage/assignment delay, waiting-on-requester delay, vendor/third-party delay, technical diagnosis/effort, approval/change-control delay, and resource/queue contention. Instead the columns are the delay outcome itself (resolution_hours = restatement), external predictors (priority, opened_hour, opened_day_of_week, is_weekend), and a potential cause (category_mismatch). The temporal columns also overlap (is_weekend is derived from opened_day_of_week). Since there are zero true facets, both mutual exclusivity and exhaustiveness with respect to the concept score 0."
}
